status: Provisional executable-content input for revised Generate; not canonical morphology or an evaluated genome.

context.pose: retained local module frames; no universal ground plane

baseline.meaning: Available inherited construction operators; no required head, neck, torso, supports, posterior, wings or face. At least one embodied volume belongs to this bounded source subset.

importedRecords.records: All34 locus definitions and allele values/maps unchanged, including exact version2 candidate pigment records. Preserve their record versions; apply new consumer guards separately, never mutate V1 definitions or saved inputs.

registries.purpose: Exact proposed authoring registry, all eleven family declarations/gaps and all locus definitions including drafts.
Current broader foundation: fifty validated contributors and six drafts. Preserve exact dependencies/operators/units; its old geometry is not the new anatomy.

fullAuthoring.inheritedUnion: Retain every validated regional-scene pair plus every anatomical V1 pair plus all sixteen new pairs. Deduplicate only exact shared version2 pigment records. Expected98 carried two-copy loci; compute/display actual counts from the pinned union. The50 construction contributors are a subset, not the full project genome.
fullAuthoring.drafts: Retain six draft definitions under exact source identities and eleven-domain index. No fake [candidate,candidate] copies or null phenotypes. Domains with no locus contract show unimplemented, not invented physiology.
fullAuthoring.canonicalSourceMap: Each definition retains source catalogue id/version, source file/export, locus id/version and exact record digest. Each inherited locus selects an exact definition reference and stores ordered copies once; branch/part views reference it. Differing same-ID/version definitions remain source-scoped variants, never silently merged; reject ambiguous selection.
fullAuthoring.sharedPigments: Identical version2 body/secondary records share one inherited pair each. Original registry version1 pigment definitions remain historical foundation references, not additional current editable pigment genes.
fullAuthoring.broaderResolution: Resolve declared validated operators into retained contribution facts, reusing supported copy resolution or matching its declared precision. Do not execute the old geometry/support-law evaluation against this graph. Unmatched old structural/marking/motion/energy/physiological consumers are unimplemented with exact copies and resolved values retained, not absent or certified phenotypes.
fullAuthoring.broaderConstructionMap: Only exact shared pigment records currently feed both broader and compositional consumers. Other broader structural/growth/ocular/covering records remain consumer-unimplemented where old geometry/axes differ. Do not replace them with similarly named overlay values, remap longitudinal position to screen coordinates or assert old capability laws on new anatomy.
fullAuthoring.recordStates: Every definition has authoring and inheritance status. Every modeled inherited record has copy-resolution status, expressed/inactive/unimplemented consumer state, resolved contribution, source versions and reason. Expressed requires an actual compatible consumer; inactive requires a declared owner/condition guard; unimplemented identifies the missing consumer/locus contract. Drafts have no invented copy-resolution.
fullAuthoring.visibleAuthoring: Show all eleven branches in the current default/Advanced authoring record, with exact locus rows and actual gaps, not only an old-package dropdown. Normalize display family aliases without changing source records.
fullAuthoring.storageStages: Separately retain foundation, inherited genome, expression/context, phenotype/part causes and lifetime state. Five storage stages do not replace eleven-domain coverage. Unmodeled lifetime/history/regulation remain explicit unmodeled states, never fabricated or made heritable; keep known provenance/assets.
fullAuthoring.identity: New inherited identity covers the entire inherited union/foundation references; new expression/source identity covers the complete retained expression/phenotype/construction/context/profiles. Never hash only the50 construction subset as a full record. Reuse the existing tree/codec where compatible without a new framework. V1 identities/replays stay exact.

operators.copy-mean: Arithmetic mean of two numeric allele values.
operators.pair-map: Explicit unordered pair map using sorted allele IDs; no fallback.
operators.imported: Imported copy-mean, dominant-enable and partition-map retain their exact V1 operators. Founder sampling is separate from expression.

loci.meaning: Symmetry of the primary region/appendage assembly. An optional facial module retains its declared bilateral local frame; derive mixed local symmetry instead of claiming every module is globally radial.
Optional new anatomical owner for the imported head/face contributors; not a required body region.
Region at depth d has anchor radii times childScale^d; no equal-length bulb requirement.
New circular YZ section; does not clamp or repurpose the carried bilateral depth/width contributions.

importedApplicability.growth.core-half-length: Always: anchor region half-length in unchanged source units; a central anchor volume is not a torso class.
importedApplicability.growth.core-width-ratio: Bilateral primary body: unchanged localY radius/anchorRx.
importedApplicability.growth.core-depth-ratio: Bilateral primary body: unchanged localZ radius/anchorRx. Both bilateral width/depth stay inactive for radial body; the new radial cross-radius supplies both transverse axes.
importedApplicability.anatomy.muzzle-presence: typedHead; resolved ON is inactive when its head owner is absent.
importedApplicability.anatomy.exterior-eye-presence: typedHead; no face added to generic volumes by fallback.
importedApplicability.anatomy.support-pair-count: Bilateral contact-chain only; retains actual two/three opposite-side stations, never becomes free-chain or radial group count.
importedApplicability.growth.support-drop-ratio: Bilateral contact-chain only; actual localZ root-to-end drop, not generic ray length.
importedApplicability.growth.support-splay-ratio: Bilateral contact-chain only; actual localY end offset.
importedApplicability.growth.terminal-depth-ratio: Contact-chain: terminal localZ radius/anchorRx; rotate the full terminal frame for radial copies.
importedApplicability.anatomy.wing-presence: Independent anchor-owned thin-surface pair in bilateral assembly or triple in radial assembly; no head, support or posterior dependency. It is a source surface module, not a flight capability.
importedApplicability.growth.wing-span-ratio: SurfaceON: unchanged outward span/anchorRx in the owner frame.
importedApplicability.growth.wing-chord-ratio: SurfaceON: unchanged longitudinal chord/anchorRx in the owner frame.
importedApplicability.growth.wing-sweep-ratio: SurfaceON: unchanged posterior sweep/span in the owner frame.
importedApplicability.anatomy.posterior-presence: Inactive in this consumer: region-depth/layout now compose generic connected regions. This record never installs a tail or abdomen in the new profile.
importedApplicability.growth.posterior-length-ratio: Inactive: no old posterior owner in the compositional consumer.
importedApplicability.growth.posterior-width-ratio: Inactive: no old posterior owner in the compositional consumer.
importedApplicability.appearance.body-palette: Always: body volumes/joins and optional head modules. Radial assembly uses body pigment on every primary/module role, with fixed ocular inks separate.
importedApplicability.appearance.underside-palette: Bilateral modular chains/terminals/surfaces only. Carried inactive for radial assembly; never a face or underside patch.
importedApplicability.appearance.anatomical-covering: Always: declared primary-region material field; skin/scales values remain exact.
importedApplicability.appearance.anatomical-covering-extent: Scales on primary regions; carried inactive for skin.
importedApplicability.appearance.anatomical-scale-size: Scales on primary regions; carried inactive for skin. Optional head/joins/chain/surface owners remain declared smooth.

founderSampling.categoricalAndPresence: At each pair-map, dominant-enable or recessive-enable locus independently choose one declared allele uniformly and assign [allele,allele]. This explicitly samples founder states rather than independently sampled copies causing75% ON or three-pair dominance. All heterozygous maps remain valid for editing and inheritance.
founderSampling.numericAndPigment: At each copy-mean or partition-map locus draw each allele copy independently and uniformly across its exact domain.
founderSampling.scope: Provisional founder support, not allele/population balance, animal quotas or an offspring sampling rule.
founderSampling.selection: First eligible complete candidate under the existing1024 total ceiling; no ranking, class quotas, genotype repair or hidden reroll. Keep exact attempted/winning copies and stage/reason failures.

construction.primaryRegionCount: serial: depth; fan:1+(depth-1)*armCount, armCount2 bilateral or3 radial. Maximum7 primary regions. Depth1 makes layout-specific growth inactive, not a missing region.
construction.serial: Parent is previous depth. Bilateral successive direction is unit([cos(d*bend),0,sin(d*bend)]); radial serial direction is +X with circular YZ sections. Store each local frame, not only centers.
construction.fan: Parent is previous depth on that arm, root is anchor. Bilateral arm directions [cos(angle),+/-sin(angle),0]. Radial arm directions [0,cos(2*pi*k/3),sin(2*pi*k/3)], k0..2 in actualXYZ. Rotate each copied local volume/attachment frame; do not splay projectedXY spokes.
construction.regionGrowth: Anchor half-length from exact imported core-half-length. Bilateral anchor radii(L,widthRatio*L,depthRatio*L); radial radii(L,crossRatio*L,crossRatio*L). Child radii are anchor radii*taper^depth in the retained child frame. No equal-size chain default.
construction.broadJoin: Solve parent/child directional ellipsoid extents. Center distance is their sum minus.20*min(extents); retain a shared inside-volume witness. No separate neck node.
construction.narrowJoin: Center distance is directional extents sum+.20*min(extents). Add a rooted connector between solved surfaces with .05*min(anchorRx,childRx) endpoint penetration and radius throatRatio*min(parent/child transverse radii). Retain true roots, parent/child frames and source contributions.
construction.typedHead: Optional head uses the imported head radii/lift and head-local exterior face/muzzle/crown operators on the anchor. Region-join decides a fused overlap or true rooted neck connection. The original head/core spacing formula applies to narrow connection; broad places the head for an actual declared shared overlap. No head baseline or auto eye/muzzle/crown.
construction.attachmentHosts: All chain/surface groups attach to the anchor actual surface. Bilateral contacts use the imported two/three stations and exact V1 local drop/splay, translated into this anchor frame rather than shifting the whole body to a universal groundZ. Free groups/radial contacts use new count0..3 and evenly spaced localX stations in[-.5L,.5L]. Count1 usesX0.

appendageConstruction.none: No chain or terminal geometry; retained chain contributions inactive. Independent surface module may still be enabled.
appendageConstruction.free: OppositeY roots for bilateral groups; three actual XYZ sector rays aroundX for radial groups. Intersect rays with the anchor at the inherited station. Proximal exact length=new proximalRatio*L, distal exact length=new distalRatio*L if two links. Bilateral direction has localZ=.35 and outwardY normalized; radial copies rotate the same local ray/frame aroundX. Bend the second link by a fixed.35radian parent-local frame rotation. Taper link radius to.55 of proximal radius and to.35 at distal end; retain actual XYZ endpoints and lengths. No terminal foot, support label or ground-plane correction.
appendageConstruction.contact: Bilateral contact operator retains two links, drop/splay and terminal dimensions from imported records. Radial contacts use new proximal/distal lengths and rotate complete chain/joint/terminal frames aroundX; old bilateral drop/splay/pair-count remain inactive. Add a distinct terminal volume at the distal endpoint, with inherited local radii and retained shared attachment. Contact geometry is not locomotion/biomechanics certification.
appendageConstruction.surface: Independent inherited surface gate. Reuse bounded rooted chord/span/sweep thin sheet and finite root mount in local anchor frame: bilateral pair or radial triple. No support rods, foot terminals or animal-name wing rig. Preserve actual depth, normals and roots.

surfaces.pigment: Preserve imported exact partition-map arrays and ordered copy provenance. Body volume localu runs longitudinal negative→positive; connector/link u runs root→tip; terminal localu runs local negativeX→positiveX; thin surface u runs root→outer edge. Rotate frames/masks together. Two palettes mean equal localu fields, no blending or whole-body half split.
surfaces.covering: Skin is the complete base. Scales apply to each primary volume localu=.20 through.20+exact extent, with exact longitudinal scale size. New compositional-surface-fields/1 uses three circumferential bands; maximumceil(.70/.12)*3*7=126 cells within128. This finite representation change is consumer-versioned, not changed inherited scale alleles or tissue depth. Joins, optional head/facial/crown volumes and chains/terminals stay smooth; thin surfaces stay smooth-thin. No fur fallback, scales-as-spikes or armour object geometry.

recordContract: Carry the full inherited union (expected98 pairs), exact broader/new foundation references, eleven-domain indexes and every expressed/inactive/unimplemented record state. The50 structural contributors are only the current constructed subset. Retain all record versions, new catalogue/rule/operator-baseline/context identities, graph frames/roots/links, base pigments/masks/materials and separate reference. Strict replay rejects input/profile/digest mismatch. V1 uses unchanged original versions.

workedInputs.base: Expand the exact imported34 V1 default pairs and new defaults below, plus all additional broader validated pairs from one explicit pinned founder input under the stated policy. Keep those broader copies unchanged across contrasts, sharing exact pigment pairs. Inputs become complete only after this expansion; fixtures never select Generate presets or award specimen identity.

examples.expected: Three unequal connected volumes in an inherited bent serial arrangement, broad joins, no head/neck/face/chains/surface. Not another fixed support rig.
Five actual volumes: anchor with two two-depth branches and retained narrow connectors. No head, limbs, terminals or surface module.
One central circular-section volume with three XYZ-rooted two-link free chains, no feet, head, neck or global groundZ.
The optional typed face/head and four/six contact-chain organization is one composition, not the shared baseline.

stop: Implement usable variable-organization Generate using these finite shared operators; inspect actual retained source later without a new test suite or source campaign. No provider trial, animal preset, class-based repair, animation, physics, canonical morphology, future catalogue project or ownership/breeding grant.
